content.title: NFR Podcast on Instagram: "J. Cole explains “The Fall-Off” and his entire discography 💿👀"
content.text: J. Cole explains “The Fall-Off” and his entire discography 💿👀from the come up to the fall off, and even when we fall off we don’t fall offSayin Off-Season and MDL as practice is crazy cus he was spittttttin fr 😮‍💨4YEO was a side quest!?!?I Can't Wait to Hear It's a BoyI created so many memories having listening sessions to Friday night lights. That’s why that one will always be my favRappers never retire, only the concepts get a break🤞🏽🤞🏽So, in a nutshell.. broski not retiring 😭😭😭🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥The Fall off is the best Cole album period.The off season is so hard thoThe Warm Up highly underrated too.The hand gestures are sending me 😂No one in hip hop history as an A List celebrity, went around fans! Literally random fans and sat with them and explained their views of their work and listened to their music…. Let them rap etc😂! This man @realcoleworld is making history in front of us! He is the closest thing we’ve seen to MJ love of the fans! I can attest that this is some real NC chill shit… ain’t no one like us globallyAnd every album been trash since FHD 😂😭I’m sorry man but every rap album coming out this year WILL BE compared to The Fall Off. Cole is the standard this year.He was done taking it seriously after Born Sinner. 2014 Forest Hills Drive is his homecoming, his “I made it, let me kick back” album. That’s why it feels like a mixtape, it’s a lot less experimental, it’s just nice raps and smooth beats that feel like home. 4 Your Eyez Only is a story he felt he had to get off his chest to honor a friend who never got the opportunity to go as far as Cole did. KOD is a reflection on substance abuse and a warning to the next generation: stay away or lose yourself. The Off-Season and Might Delete Later are very explicitly casual lyrical exercises, they’re practise with no pressure, a 180 on Friday Night Lights. The Fall Off is simply the result of getting deeper into his career, as he slips away from the very top, but intentionally and without losing control. He had nothing to prove after Born Sinner, that was it for him, and from then on he loosened up and did what he felt like
